description: This file defines the OpenClawChatViewModel class, which manages chat session state, message handling, session switching, model selection, and interaction with the OpenClaw chat transport. It serves as the primary view model for the OpenClawChatUI component, handling logic for sending messages, receiving events, and maintaining session data.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: A final class implementing observable chat session management, message state, model/session switching, and communication with the chat transport.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ChatViewModel with a session key, transport, optional initial thinking level, and callback for thinking level changes. Sets up an event task to listen to transport events.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Triggers the bootstrap process to initialize chat session state.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reinitializes the chat session by calling bootstrap.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Performs sending of user input and attachments as a message.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the latest session list from the transport.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches current session to the specified session key.

methods.name: selectThinkingLevel
methods.description: Changes the thinking level for the current session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Sets the current model selection for the session.
